mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate indicates monetary easing, which may stimulate economic activity and lead to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS decreases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of the next 20-day periods.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in the unemployment rate suggests economic weakness, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE increases by 0.2pp in one month
failure_condition: If UNRATE rises but S&P 500 returns remain positive in more than 50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production indicates a supply slowdown, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO declines by 0.5% in one month
failure_condition: If INDPRO declines but S&P 500 returns are positive in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts indicates strong demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: HOUST increases by 5% in one month
failure_condition: If HOUST increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Rising employment and unemployment rate together signal labor market strength, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If both PAYEMS and UNRATE rise but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 40% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong retail sales growth indicates high consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 days.
candidate_trigger: RSAFS increases by 3% in one month
failure_condition: If RSAFS increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 35% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth indicates economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 days.
failure_condition: If GDPC1 grows but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 30% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Strong payroll growth indicates a robust labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases by 150k jobs in one month
failure_condition: If PAYEMS increases but S&P 500 returns are negative in more than 25% of cases.
